slides.heading: Get it checked promptly if
items: Can't lift it after a fall

caption:
Shoulder fine during the day, but grumbling once you lie down?

At night, sensitive shoulder tissues can get squashed or stretched, and there's less to distract you. Night pain is common with many shoulder problems and often eases as things settle.

On your back, rest a pillow under the sore arm so it sits slightly out from your side. If you sleep on your side, lie on the good side and hug a pillow so the sore arm doesn't fall forward. Give the arm-under-pillow habit a break for now.

Night pain that keeps getting worse, or a shoulder you can't lift after a fall, is worth assessing promptly. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐨
